description_en: Deletes the routing relationships of a specified custom topic
description_zh: 调用该接口删除指定自定义Topic的路由关系
name: DeleteTopicRouteTable

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no <props="intl"><ph>Overview page or </ph></props>ID is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The source topic, which is the topic being subscribed to. Example: `SrcTopic.1=/x7aWKW9****/testDataToDataHub/user/update`
parameters.name: src_topic

parameters.help_en: The destination topic, which subscribes to messages from SrcTopic. Examples: `DstTopic.1=/x7aWKW9****/deviceNameTest1/user/add` and `DstTopic.2=/x7aWKW9****/deviceNameTest2/user/delete`
parameters.name: dst_topic

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

IsAllSucceed.description_en:
Indicates whether all specified topic routing relationships are deleted.
true: All routing relationships are deleted.
false: Not all routing relationships are deleted
IsAllSucceed.description_zh:
指定的Topic路由关系是否全部成功删除。
true：全部成功删除。
false：未全部成功删除

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful.
true: The call is successful.
false: The call fails
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
